out.explanation: Statement A on page 369 refers to total borrowings including non-fund-based limits aggregated to ₹509.67 million, whereas Statement B on page 364 breaks this down into fund-based borrowings (₹88.85 million), non-fund-based borrowings (₹410.63 million), and unsecured loans (₹10.19 million).
